column1: # Repair slices: one row per path a task in the repair round (31-35) owns.
# Generated from two measured sets on ux-v270-omp-alignment/30 (which carries the
# `unexplained` (646 paths), and every file `bun check --all` reports a type
# error in (1,130 errors in 214 distinct files; the run's 219 error-file blocks
# name 214 paths because five files are checked by two projects). `source` says
# which of the two findings put the path here. Both sets are assignments only:
# `slice` follows the Files lists in tasks 31-35: sections and snippets 31;
# session 32; chat, layout, views, multirun, ui, onboarding, projects,
# sourceBoard, desktop, comments, references, apps and App.tsx 33; sync, stores,
# api and contexts 34; everything else (ui lib/hooks/types, web client, docs,
# sdk, electron, extensions, mobile, scripts, root config and docs) 35.
